requires.label: Colorado resident
requires.quote: Financial assistance is available for emergent or medically necessary care to all individuals who reside in Colorado and have established care with Vail Health.

requires.label: Emergent or medically necessary care
requires.quote: Financial assistance is available for emergent or medically necessary care to all individuals who reside in Colorado and have established care with Vail Health.

rules.label: Uninsured Eligibility
rules.quote: Eligibility for all uninsured patients will be is based on meeting residency and income requirements.

rules.label: Presumptive Eligibility
rules.quote: Eligibility in state or federally funded programs. Examples include housing assistance, food stamps and the Women, Infants & Children program (WIC).

rules.label: Financial Assistance Discount Tier 1 (<=250% FPL)
rules.quote: Patients eligible for financial assistance at less than 250% of Federal Poverty Level (FPL) will not be charged more than the amount collected from Vail Health’s lowest commercial contracted payer.

notes: Services conducted by a different medical provider other than Vail Health (even if performed in a Vail Health facility) fall outside of the policy scope and are not eligible for Vail Health financial assistance. Examples include Vail Valley Surgery Center, The Steadman Clinic, Vail-Summit Orthopedics & Neurosurgery, Anesthesia Partners Colorado (APC, Cardinal Pathology, Critical Care & Pulmonary Consults, Obstetrics/Pediatrics (Neonatal Nursey)-only services performed at Vail Health Hospital, excluding CMM providers. Services provided at the Vail Valley Surgery Center, Dillon Surgery Center and Steadman Philippon Surgery Center.
Patients eligible for Colorado’s Hospital Discounted Care will receive letters within 14 days of the receipt of the completed application

Once a patient has been approved for financial assistance or Hospital Discounted Care, the patient will be deemed to have approval for financial assistance towards services rendered by Vail Health for 12 months subsequent to approval.

If a patient is granted financial assistance on a portion of the bill and the patient subsequently does not pay his/her remaining portion of the bill, Vail Health will not reverse the amount of financial assistance granted.
rule_uninsured_eligibility may leave out a condition: Missing residency requirement (must reside in Colorado).
rule_presumptive_eligibility may leave out a condition: Missing residency requirement (must reside in Colorado).
